about: Accommodation rewards (#146; additions "Accommodation rewards"; question #486; decision 0246). A member earns hotel nights by the hours they play: when a visit closes, the time played at each table (the call-time clock's, as points by the hour use it) earns that table type's accommodation.hours_per_night share of a night. Nights are kept in thousandths, rounded down per table, so hours at different stakes and on different visits add up. A hotel-night reward in the catalogue costs whole nights. Inputs are seconds played and hours a night; expected is thousandths of a night.

cases.description: Twenty hours at a stake of twenty hours a night: one whole night.
Five hours at twenty hours a night: a quarter of a night.
Two hours 59 minutes at twenty hours a night is 149.17 thousandths: rounded down to 149.
Exactly 72 seconds at twenty hours a night: one thousandth.
A second short of 72 at twenty hours a night: nothing yet.
Ten hours in the Private Room at eight hours a night: a night and a quarter.
A whole week at the table, 168 hours, at 40 hours a night: 4.2 nights.
